verdict.rationale: Northwest Registered Agent runs an online business-formation and registered-agent platform, so whether its software is published under an open license is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack has nothing about source code, repositories, or licensing. The only probe hit a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt, so no first-party content could be read. The single community comment is about the company's SEO and is irrelevant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
